title: Prosthetic Femoral Access for Haemodialysis
brief_summary: This study will compare the outcomes of tunneled femoral catheter and femoro-femoral arteriovenous graft as a bailout procedure for hemodialysis in chronic kidney disease patients with exhausted upper-extremity and chest-wall vascular accesses regarding survival rate, complications, and quality of life
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All end-stage renal disease patients who complain of exhaustion of all upper-extremity and chest-wall vascular accesses.
* ≥ 15 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with previous history or evident deep venous thrombosis
* varicose veins
* femoral vein stenosis
* arterial insufficiency
* severe groin or limb infection.
